column1: # Nicapetre, Braila - the elliptical hall. Two levels, one volume.
# The outer wall is an ellipse, major axis 10.00 m, minor 8.00 m. The ceiling
# void (7.00 x 5.00 m) is concentric with it, leaving a ~1.50 m gallery all the
# way round upstairs. Ground floor 4.20 m, upper 3.60 m.
# UNLIKE monitors.tsv, THE HEIGHTS HERE ARE REAL. Hala MX puts all twelve
# monitors at Z = 1.80 m and fakes every vertical cue with Blauert bands; this
# room has a genuine 4 m shaft between the two rings, so up and down are
# physical and the band pair is not needed to state them.
# Azimuth 0 deg = North (the marble stair), increasing clockwise, so 90 = East
# and 270 = West - the two curved doorways. Ring radius is nominal: the gallery
# rail is an ellipse, not a circle, so the four are at equal ANGLE, not equal
# distance. That asymmetry is the room's, and it is left in.
